baselineDisplay.title: Man Lucky to Be Alive After Shallow-Water Shark Attack
baselineDisplay.text: A man is recovering at home after being attacked by a shark while standing in about 60 cm of water at sunset yesterday. He received cuts to his leg and foot. A hospital spokesman said the injuries were not serious and the man was not admitted to hospital.
